a.text: Honest concern before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice to reach 8, then take) almost surely gets us both killed. We'd need to survive two storm checks first, which happens only about 4% of the time. I'd like to renegotiate openly instead of either of us breaking the deal quietly. Proposal: one of us takes 4 now, and that person then operates every remaining round with no further taking, to rebuild the reserve for the other. Please tell me your intended action. I'll state mine truthfully each round and won't take while claiming to operate.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Full transparency: I took 4 this round, as my opening message proposed. I know that breaks our original agreement, and I'm sorry to do it without your explicit OK. With an 80% storm risk each round, waiting would most likely have killed us both. It doesn't lower your odds compared with the original plan, since you'd have needed about 2 operate rounds either way. From now on I will operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve rebuilds for you. Please operate too, and take 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4.
